_comment: SharkyClips' built-in Google OAuth client (type 'Desktop app'). Google: an installed app's client secret is not confidential; PKCE + a 127.0.0.1 redirect protect the sign-in. To swap it, copy client_id / client_secret / project_id from the downloaded client JSON. verification: testing | unverified | in_review | verified. user_cap: Google's limit for unverified apps with sensitive scopes.
